import os,re,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import collections,os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; cs={(i,j)}
                while st:
                    q=st.pop()
                    for dq in [(q[0]+1,q[1]),(q[0]-1,q[1]),(q[0],q[1]+1),(q[0],q[1]-1)]:
                        if 0<=dq[0]<H and 0<=dq[1]<W and g[dq[0]][dq[1]]!=bg and dq not in cs:

                seen|=cs; out.append(cs)
    return out

        sig=tuple(sorted(((p[0]-mr,p[1]-mc),scolor) for p in sd))
        for p in oset-sd:
            off=(p[0]-mr,p[1]-mc)
            slotcnt[(sig,off)][go[p[0]][p[1]]]+=1

bg=C(v for r in I for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]

added={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if O[i][j]!=I[i][j]}
print('added cells:',sorted(added))
# which comp color maps to which stamp
ic=comps_c4(I,bg)
for c in ic:
    col=I[c[0][0]][c[0][1]]
    print(col, sorted(c))

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

    return G

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
